title: Hangover Cure Irish Grana Padano Stew
description: A hearty, diabetes-friendly Irish stew featuring the funky, glassy-jelly goodness of Grana Padano. Perfect for a hangover cure after a night out with friends.

ingredients.name: Bay leaves
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried, whichever is available

instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat a drizzle of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the pork sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Set the sausages aside and add the diced onions and carrots to the pot.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef broth, potatoes, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot.
Return the sausages to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium low and cook, covered, until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the grated Grana Padano cheese until melted and serve hot.
Season with black pepper to taste.
